description: General purpose utilities, including Logging, settings (.ini / json) files and encryption of stored credentials (DPAPI / AES).
releaseNotes:
2.1.3 - JsonSettings: automatic update of the settings in use when the file is modified while the application is running, applied to the properties marked with the new [AutoUpdate] attribute (AutoUpdate(), timer StartAutoUpdate/StopAutoUpdate, event AutoUpdated, overridable AutoUpdateCustomLogic, result JsonSettingsAutoUpdateResult); Load assigns the static property of the current settings declared by the derived class (named Current or marked with the new [CurrentSettings] attribute) before Init only while it is null, otherwise it updates only its [AutoUpdate] properties and returns the instance in use, except with the new overload Load(createIfNotExists, options, doNotAssignCurrent) for the default file (the existing signatures do not change); the reasons of an invalid file reported by AutoUpdate can be supplied by the derived class (overridable AutoUpdateInvalidFileProblems).
- JsonSettings: new MigrateFromIniFile to create the JSON file from Settings.ini, with default conversion of the types, overridable MigrateFromIniFileCustomLogic and result JsonSettingsMigrationResult<T>.
- Paths: new MigrateToAppdata to move the default directories, Settings.ini and the additional items of the application from AssemblyPath to <AssemblyPath>/Appdata and activate the new base (result PathsMigrationResult). IniFileHelper with the default path looks for Settings.ini in AssemblyPath and, if missing, in AppdataDirectory.
- IniFileHelper: new TryGetBool and TryGetInt.
- Note: a class derived from JsonSettings with a static property Current of its own type now gets it assigned by Load, and a second Load no longer replaces it.

2.1.2 - CredentialProtector: the constructor accepts a null entropy, read from __credentials.entropy in Paths.DefaultConfigsDirectory and created on first use with 32 random bytes (mode 600 on systems other than Windows); new public CreateOrReadEntropyFile(path) and constants DEFAULTENTROPYFILENAME, DEFAULTENTROPYSIZE. Deleting or replacing the entropy file makes the values encrypted with it no longer decryptable.

2.1.1 - IniFileHelper.Save keeps the layout of the existing INI file (comments, pragmas, key names, alignment), using SettingsTemplate.ini only when the file does not exist yet; keys and arrays removed with the new Remove method are dropped, new ones are appended at the end.

2.1.0 - New Security.CredentialProtector: encryption of stored credentials with DPAPI (Windows) or AES and a key file (other systems; AES-GCM on .NET 8, AES-CBC + HMAC-SHA256 on .NET Standard 2.0), also for credentials embedded in a string between configurable tags (default [PWD] / [/PWD]). New dependency System.Security.Cryptography.ProtectedData 8.0.0.
- Logging: SimpleLogger and SimpleLog can archive the log files of the months before the current one and the previous ArchiveRetentionMonths months (default 1, minimum 1) into a monthly PREFIXLog_YYYY_MM.zip in the log folder; no log or zip file is ever deleted. The check runs on a background thread whenever the log file name changes (first write, change of date, folder or prefix). New EnableArchiving (default false), ArchiveRetentionMonths and ArchiveLogs().
- JsonSettings.Save: new optional parameter ignoreBackup (default false) to overwrite the file without saving a backup copy. Assemblies compiled against 2.0.x that call Save must be recompiled.
- CSVLogItem: the netstandard2.0 build writes DateOnly properties in ISO format (yyyy-MM-ddT00:00:00) like the .NET 8 build, instead of a quoted string in the current culture.

2.0.1 - WebDownloader: optional CancellationToken and inactivity timeout on Download and DownloadAsync; an interrupted download deletes the partial file. Assemblies compiled against 2.0.0 that call WebDownloader must be recompiled.

2.0.0 - Breaking changes, see README for details and migration notes.
- PasswordHash/PasswordHelper: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 with 600,000 iterations, 49-byte versioned hashes and constant-time comparison; 1.x hashes (36 bytes) are still verified and flagged by RequiresRehash.
- Logging: until LogPath is assigned, SimpleLogger, SimpleLog and CSVLogger follow Paths.DefaultLogsDirectory; DEBUG/PROTOCOL labels in DebugWrite/ProtocolWrite lines; ConditionalLog with independent console and file thresholds.
- PropertyStringUtils uses its CultureInfo (default CurrentCulture) instead of the thread culture; an invalid string leaves nullable fields unchanged.
- JsonSettings.Load uses DefaultSerializerOptions; backup names without double dot.
- NetUtils.CheckDNS returns Reachable false for unknown hosts; EmbeddedResourcesUtils throws InvalidOperationException for a missing resource; DaysOfWeekParameter throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException; CSVLogItem writes null values as "".
- OSKIsNumeric returns bool, SimpleLog.ConsoleLog is static, IPAddressExtensionMethods.TryParseMatch(string, out IPAddress) is obsolete.
- Bug fixes in ODBC connection string, GCUtils, Paths, PagingCollection, StringUtils, IniFileHelper and WebDownloader; thread-safe PasswordObfuscator and OSKRandom.Shared.
